system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You have trained your body and mind to resist the wills of others through use of medical techniques and martial practice. When you are forced to make a saving throw to resist a Physical or Mental condition as a result of a hostile creature, you can choose to make the saving throw using the higher ability based on your Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait (Strength or Intelligence saving throw)

Additionally, Banes can now be infused into any Jutsu you cast with the Medical or Inhaled keywords that you cast.
